name: installment-select
description: Brazilian installment payment selector with automatic calculation of interest and installment values

behavior.calculation: Generates options from 1x to maxInstallments, applying compound interest after freeInstallments
behavior.minimumValue: Stops generating options when installment value drops below minInstallmentValue
behavior.display: Shows 'sem juros' badge for interest-free, 'à vista' for 1x, total with interest for others

doesNot: Validate card numbers or perform anti-fraud checks
requires: Backend integration with a payment gateway for actual card processing
Your gateway's installment configuration to determine real interest rates

states.name: selected
states.description: One installment option is selected (green border + radio)

context.whenToUse: In any Brazilian checkout flow where credit card payment with installments is offered
context.whenNotToUse: For Pix or boleto payments (those are single-payment). For non-Brazilian checkouts
context.accessibility: Uses radiogroup role with aria-checked on each option
context.culturalNote: Parcelamento (installments) is a cornerstone of Brazilian e-commerce. Most purchases over ~R$ 100 are split into 2-12 monthly installments on credit cards. 'Sem juros' (interest-free) is a major selling point. Stores absorb the interest to attract customers. '10x de R$ 14,99 sem juros' is the standard display format.
